manifest.design: Fixed requested projected radii; equally spaced bearings; adjacent widths; ordered output; at most two concurrent planner calls

method.method: integrated directional derivative of the prepared 2D terrain surface
method.graph_chainage: cumulative geodesic vertex lengths scaled to stored segment length
method.profile_kind: estimated terrain height change from each valid run start

signals.unavailable_reason: Crossing passage attribution is not prepared.

busy_roads.unavailable_reason: Buffered road context is not prepared.

greenery.unavailable_reason: Buffered green-area context is not prepared.

selection: Lowest start/radius-balanced relative RMSE in leave-one-start-out predictions, nonzero widths only. Exploratory model selection, not an untouched final test.
loss: Weighted squared error of (L-baseline)/r; equal total weight per represented start/radius cell. Both orientations averaged before fitting. No outlier removal, clipping or robust loss.
equation: L=b+r*[P(q)+(b/r-2)*Q(q)+(r/10000)*S(q)], q=width/0.6; polynomials have no constant terms; omit Q/S for simpler families
